title: Limitations.
officialText:
The length of the fabric or safety wire perpendicular to any edge of the sign structure shall be
dimensioned such that in the event of failure of any part of the flexible sign structure, no load spreader bars, mechanical
tensioning devices, clamps, or wires will strike any nearby doors, windows, vents, chimneys, grilles, skylights, light fixtures,
decorations or other wall appurtenances, or mechanical equipment, nor shall any load spreader bar fall within 10 feet (3048
mm) of grade.
SECTION BC H115
PORTABLE SIGNS
